thread:
maria-g: FYI seeing multiple orgs with $0 or NaN on the Token Cost dashboard starting ~2026-03-17T16:10Z. Reported by customer success.

support-bot: Created ticket #SUP-8421 and linked reporter's org ids. https://rwinf.ticket/SUP-8421 :eyes:

alan-k: Thx. Can you paste 2-3 org IDs + exact time range you saw this in the dashboard?

maria-g: Sure — sample orgs: org_88f2, org_b2a9, org_cc331. Time range: Mar 17 15:30-16:30 UTC. Dashboard shows NaN for token_cost and $0 for some orgs. Screenshot: https://files.redwood/screenshots/8421.png

dave-s: grabbing ledger + price join now. Quick check — running aggregate against prod replica.

alan-k: If you can, include the SQL you ran (we should be able to reproduce locally).

Dave-s: SQL I used:
```sql
SELECT o.org_id, sum(u.tokens) as tokens, p.price_per_token
FROM usage_aggregates u
LEFT JOIN model_pricing p ON u.model_id = p.model_id
LEFT JOIN orgs o ON u.org_id = o.id
WHERE u.org_id IN ('org_88f2','org_b2a9','org_cc331')
  AND u.window_start >= '2026-03-17T15:30:00Z'::timestamptz
GROUP BY o.org_id, p.price_per_token;
```

Dave-s: For org_b2a9 the price_per_token is NULL which makes cost calc return NULL/NaN in our dashboard.

alan-k: That smells like the model_pricing table missing entries for new model variants introduced in the model-catalog migration. We switched to model_variant ids last week — possible gap in the backfill.

julie-p: Could also be that the pricing ingestion job skipped rows when currency conversion service returned 502. We saw transient failures around 15:05 UTC. logs: `pricing-ingest ERROR 502 during fx lookup`

maria-g: Customer-facing note: reporter says they were charged correctly (billing ledger has entries) but dashboard is blank/zero. So internal ledger may be fine; it's the cost calc / dashboard pipeline.

alan-k: Good — that means ledger JOIN is fine but the derived metric pipeline likely uses model_pricing table directly. Two parallel actions: 1) immediate dashboard-side guard to stop showing NaN/$0, 2) root-cause fix for missing pricing rows and the ingestion flaky path.

dave-s: Quick repro curl to fetch aggregated cost that dashboard uses:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPRO_TOKEN" \
  "https://console-api.redwood/v1/orgs/org_b2a9/costs?start=2026-03-17T15:30Z&end=2026-03-17T16:30Z" | jq .
```
Sample response we get locally: `{
  "org_id": "org_b2a9",
  "tokens": 125430,
  "cost": null  
}`

alan-k: For quick mitigation I propose we patch the cost calculation to COALESCE(price_per_token, fallback_price) where fallback_price is looked up by model_family or org default. This prevents NaN and surfaces a note on dashboard that price was inferred.

julie-p: Totally ok as a short-term UX fix, but we should also flag any inferred prices in the per-org billing audit so we don't hide a missing mapping.

maria-g: Customer comms: we'll tell impacted customers we're investigating a display issue and confirm billing is unaffected. Good to have a safe UI fallback so they stop seeing $0.

alan-k: Plan:
- (P0) Patch dashboard calc to COALESCE and add a `price_inferred` boolean flag in the response — rollout to staging in 15m, prod after smoke.
- Run backfill job to populate missing model_pricing rows from model_catalog history and fx fallback logs.
- Add unit + integration tests to pricing ingestion to fail loudly on FX 5xx.
- Create analytics alert for >0.5% of orgs with NULL price_per_token in a 1h window.

dave-s: I started a PR with the COALESCE fix: https://rwinf.pr/metrics/1162 — includes SQL change and a feature flag `metrics.pricing_coalesce`.

metrics-bot: Alert created: metrics.pricing.null-price-rate > 0.5% triggered at 2026-03-17T16:12Z — linked: https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/price-null-rate-317

julie-p: Also adding a quick reconciliation run against the billing ledger to confirm customers won't be under/over billed. I'll kick that off and paste results here when done.

maria-g: Thanks. Assigning support follow-up to me and eng-metrics for customer comms + root cause. Customer success asked for ETA — can we tell them ~4h for staging hotfix and 24-48h for full backfill?

alan-k: Sounds reasonable. I'll own the staging rollout. If anyone hits issues ping me.

dave-s: Backfill plan: extract missing (model_id, model_variant) from usage_aggregates where no matching model_pricing and left join to model_catalog history to restore price_per_token. Running a dry run now.

maria-g: Good progress. Keep this thread updated — I'll put a short note into the ticket and ping the reporter after staging deploy. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Ticket SUP-8421 updated: assigned_to=eng-metrics, priority=P0, mitigation=metrics.pricing_coalesce feature flag.

julie-p: Reconciliation done — billing ledger totals match expected charges for the sample orgs. No billing corrections needed. Will attach CSV to ticket.

alan-k: Staging deploy succeeded at 2026-03-17T16:28Z, feature flag on. Dashboard now shows inferred price and cost for org_b2a9.

maria-g: Customer notified with interim explanation and staging link. They appreciated the quick update.

alan-k: Moving root cause backlog items to eng-metrics sprint. Will monitor alert and schedule backfill for overnight run. Closing thread for now.

maria-g: Thanks all — great cross-team response.
